channel.title: The Wilson Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Wilson Times (wilsontimes.com)

item.title: First dog finds home through Wilson's Pets for Patriots program
item.description: After losing his longtime dog, Air Force veteran Thomas Welch becomes the first to adopt through Pets for Patriots at the Wilson County shelter, bringing home rescue pup Benji.

item.title: Voting machines checked for accuracy
item.description: The Wilson County Board of Elections is running logic and accuracy tests on all 30-plus voting machines, checking every ballot style and error type ahead of the March primary.

item.title: History reveals 4 mistakes America is making
item.description: An author argues the U.S. is repeating four destructive historical patterns — robberbaron wealth, monarchy-style power, entrenched discrimination and a misused “Kingdom of God” that have long threatened democracy.

item.title: Failure in Europe’s past offers good reason for celebration today
item.description: A new history shows how medieval Europe’s failed power struggles between popes and emperors revived republican self-government and shaped Western liberty, including America’s founding ideals.

item.title: Minnesota murders shoot a hole in the Overton window
item.description: The killings of ICU nurse Alex Pretti and Renee Good by immigration police in Minneapolis have sharply shifted public opinion and pushed Congress to consider cutting funds to DHS, ICE and the Border Patrol.

item.title: Why parents and students should care about academic freedom
item.description: A UNC professor warns that political attacks, tenure delays and new syllabus rules are eroding academic freedom, threatening the value of North Carolina public university degrees and the state’s economy.

item.title: Area Calendar, Jan. 28-29, 2026
item.description: Area sports calendar for Jan. 28-29, 2026: college men’s and women’s basketball, men’s volleyball, and a full slate of high school basketball, winter track and JV games.

item.title: Area swimmers headed to 5-A East Regional meet in Cary
item.description: Hunt, Fike, Southern Nash and C.B. Aycock send key swimmers — including No. 1 sprint seed Gavin Woolet — to Friday’s NCHSAA 5-A East Regional meet in Cary.

item.title: High school schedule thaw leads to glut of games rest of week
item.description: Winter storm school closures have crammed Wilson-area high school basketball into a packed midweek schedule, with many games moved to Wednesday and Thursday and more wintry weather possibly affecting later dates.
